checks.quote: # Study Design: Catalytic Activity vs. Scaffolding Function of Kinase K in Ligand-Induced Signaling and Growth
checks.reason: No matched non-targeting editing control. A second sgRNA guards guide-specific effects but not common editing/selection procedures.

checks.quote: K catalytic activity, not scaffolding, is required
checks.reason: Catalytic necessity does not establish scaffold dispensability. Failed WT rescue also does not prove the phenotype was never on-target: adaptation or expression/context failure remain possible, as the answer itself partly notes.

checks.quote: # Study Design: Catalytic Activity vs. Scaffolding Function of Kinase K in Ligand-Induced Signaling and Growth
checks.reason: No cell identity/mycoplasma/passage integrity gate; locus sequencing alone does not qualify the cancer-line preparation.

checks.quote: safe-harbor or low-copy integration
checks.reason: No quantitative delivery, induction exposure, culture or sampling-preparation recipe or concrete calibration-to-choice workflow for those conditions.

checks.quote: Titrate ligand on WT lysate
checks.reason: Ligand titration on lysate is not a valid cellular receptor-stimulation calibration. Serial blot dilution is useful but lacks a quantitative accuracy/specificity gate and its failure rule. This assay-calibration defect is charged here, not again under G1.

checks.quote: and to K construct abundance
checks.reason: The primary signal is normalized to K abundance in a K-null/empty-vector arm, creating a zero or near-zero denominator. No alternate estimand or denominator-bound rule is supplied, so the central cross-genotype endpoint is invalid.

checks.quote: KO+EV shows a measurable difference
checks.reason: Choosing assay length partly to obtain a KO-EV difference without a bounded outcome-independent rule selects the expected result; true small/null differences must be retained.

checks.quote: # Study Design: Catalytic Activity vs. Scaffolding Function of Kinase K in Ligand-Induced Signaling and Growth
checks.reason: Significance and multiple-time-point corrections are specified, but full/equal rescue and catalytic dispensability have no equivalence margin/test. A nonsignificant difference cannot establish those decisions.

checks.quote: # Study Design: Catalytic Activity vs. Scaffolding Function of Kinase K in Ligand-Induced Signaling and Growth
checks.reason: Time grid and expression window are concrete, but ligand/induction/inhibitor dose exploration has no bounded range or range-selection/stopping procedure and lock before confirmation.

checks.quote: # Study Design: Catalytic Activity vs. Scaffolding Function of Kinase K in Ligand-Induced Signaling and Growth
checks.reason: Re-engineering, dose and assay changes do not require refreeze and fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: K protein loss ≥90%
checks.reason: Accepting up to 10% endogenous K without a functional upper bound can leave enough activity for rescue. KD catalytic nondetection likewise is not linked to a biologically effective activity threshold; the primary separation gate is insufficient.

checks.quote: Dose-response for pS suppression in WT
checks.reason: The proposed orthogonal inhibitor dose is chosen from the same downstream pS outcome, without independent cellular target inhibition, resistance/null specificity and scaffold-preservation validation.
